items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps dull-looking skin fresh without stripping it.
Hyaluronic serum adds a hydrated, brighter-looking finish and suits the lower moisture score.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a smoother, more comfortable skin surface without feeling heavy on oily skin.
Mineral SPF 50 helps protect skin from daily sun and is a pregnancy-friendly choice for a brighter-looking complexion.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% peel and our other strong exfoliating acids and retinoids, because they are not a good fit during pregnancy, so please ask your prenatal provider or a dermatologist before adding any. Use the cleanser, serum and moisturizer morning and night, and finish your morning routine with the SPF.
